# Oak Tree Mobility

> UK specialist in handmade mobility furniture and sleep technology solutions including rise and recline chairs, adjustable beds, and bath lifts with customization options.

Oak Tree Mobility is a British manufacturer of premium mobility and comfort furniture designed for elderly care and accessibility. The company offers custom-built products featuring advanced technologies like dual motors, medical-grade foam, and SoundAsleep sleep technology, with options for fabric selection and home consultations.

## Key Topics

- Rise and Recline Chairs
- Adjustable Beds
- Dual Motor Technology
- Medical Grade™ Foam
- Customization Options
- Bath Lifts
- Parker Knoll
- SoundAsleep Sleep Engine
- Handmade Furniture
- Elderly Care
- Mattress Options
- Home Consultation
- UK Manufacturing
- Heritage Collection
- Pocket Sprung

## Rise and Recline Chairs

- [Rise and Recline Chairs](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs): Main product catalog for custom-built rise and recline chairs collection
- [Serenity](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/serenity): Serenity electric rise and recline chair with customization options
- [The Oak Rise and Recline Chair](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/the-oak): The Oak dual motor rise and recline chair with classic British design
- [The Maple Rise and Recline Chair](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/the-maple): The Maple dual motor customizable rise and recline chair collection
- [The Cedar Rise and Recline Chair](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/the-cedar): The Cedar dual motor rise and recline chair for elderly care comfort
- [The Tulip Rise and Recline Chair](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/the-tulip): The Tulip made-to-measure dual motor rise and recline chair
- [The Rowan Rise and Recline Chair](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/the-rowan): The Rowan dual motor accessibility furniture with customization
- [Heritage Collection](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/heritage-collection): Heritage Collection featuring Morris & Co. premium fabric options
- [Parker Knoll](https://oaktreemobility.co.uk/rise-and-recline-chairs/parker-knoll): Parker Knoll riser recliner chairs including Ashton and Kingswood models
